title: Final volume A
description: Essential: Correct numerical value for V1 (3.76e-3 m³) must be present.

title: Final volume B
description: Essential: Correct numerical value for V2 (6.24e-3 m³) must be present.

title: Applies Boyle's Law
description: Important: States or uses pV = constant for each gas's isothermal process.

title: Pressure equilibrium condition
description: Important: Recognizes final pressures in A and B are equal after rotation.

title: Volume conservation
description: Important: States total volume V1 + V2 equals initial sum (0.01 m³).

title: Correct unit handling
description: Optional: Converts cmHg to Pa or uses consistent units in ratio calculations.

title: Significant figures
description: Optional: Final answers expressed with appropriate significant figures (e.g., 3.76e-3).

title: Pressure unit confusion
description: Pitfall: Treats cmHg as SI unit without conversion, leading to incorrect pressure ratio.

title: Misapplies gas law
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong process (e.g., adiabatic) or assumes equal volume change.
